messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired - service=text-gen - symptom=p99_latency > 1.0s for 4m, alert=textgen_p99_high_euw1
oncall-bot: note: traffic normal but tail latency increasing since 11:10 UTC, throughput steady, small increase in longer inputs.
Sam: oncall, looking. Can someone pull p99 by model and region?
Nisha: running prom query now: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"text-gen\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}[5m])) by (le,model))`
Omar: model=redwood-v2-quant shows p99 ~1.6s, redwood-v2-ptq ~950ms. quant variant seems bad. Any recent config changes?
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: redwood-v2-quant @ 11:02 UTC by claire  rollout: 100%
Claire: yep, small kernel tweak to experiment with fused attention. Rolling back takes ~15m but we can route traffic to ptq variant quickly.
Sam: two quick mitigations: 1) switch default model for eu-west-1 to ptq for requests > 2k tokens? 2) temporarily increase inference pool workers for quant variant while rollback prepared. Which is fastest?
Nisha: I can flip routing to prefer ptq for all requests under 8k tokens, doing now. Patch API: `POST /routing` payload: `{\"service\":\"text-gen\",\"region\":\"eu-west-1\",\"weights\":{\"redwood-v2-ptq\":0.7,\"redwood-v2-quant\":0.3}}`
Nisha: applied. Should see shift within 20s.
Omar: spinning up +3 workers for quant pool to drain backlog. `infracli scale text-gen-eu --workers +3`
Claire: I've started a selective rollback on canary hosts to validate kernel change.
Sam: good. I'll silence the p99 alert for eu-west-1 for 40m while we stabilize (will annotate incident).
Nisha: note to #incidents: "p99 spike in eu-west-1 traced to fused-attn kernel change on redwood-v2-quant. Mitigated by routing to ptq and scaling workers. No 5xx spike seen. Postmortem: dashboard + alert tuning."
Claire: any customer tickets?
Omar: Support reported two customers seeing slow responses; not widespread. No 503s.
Sam: severity Sev-3. Availability OK, latency elevated for some models.
Nisha: Handoff - I'm off in 30m; Omar will take primary until EOD. Omar -> Claire for next day shift.
Sam: after-action items: tune alerts to avoid noise from model rollouts, add runbook steps for kernel-change rollbacks, and build a Grafana retro dashboard focusing on model-variant tails.
Omar: suggestion for alert rule: switch from fixed p99 threshold to a relative change alert: e.g., p99_current / median_3h > 1.8 AND p99_current > 0.8s. This avoids firing on sustained higher baselines.
Claire: short-term tweak: increase p99 threshold in eu-west-1 from 1.0s -> 1.25s and set for: 12m. We can implement anomaly rule in follow-up.
Nisha: dashboard plan - create a dashboard folder `postmortems/incident-dashboards` and dashboard `text-gen-model-variant-tail-1943216789`. Panels to include:
- latency heatmap (p50/p90/p95/p99) by model + region
- per-model request distribution (histogram)
- worker pool queue length and GPU mem util per node
- recent deploys (deploy-bot annotations) timeline
- alert firing timeline (Alertmanager) with links to runbook
- sample slow request examples / traces panel with link to distributed-tracing UI

Omar: useful panel queries (Prometheus):
```
# p99 by model
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"text-gen\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}[5m])) by (le,model))

# worker queue length by node
sum(queue_length{service=\"text-gen\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}) by (node)
```
Nisha: I'll add drilldowns from the p99 cell to `?var-model=$__cell&var-region=eu-west-1` so you can jump to per-model dashboards. Also adding a panel that overlays deploy annotations so we can correlate latency shifts with deploys.
Claire: for alertmanager rule snippet (temp):
```
- alert: TextGenHighP99EUW1
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"text-gen\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.25
  for: 12m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "text-gen p99 high in eu-west-1"
```
Follow-up: replace with anomaly detection comparing to rolling baseline.
Sam: assignments:
- Nisha: create Grafana dashboard + panels + drilldowns, link runbook (ETA today EOD)
- Claire: finish rollback validation and produce perf test comparison (ETA tomorrow)
- Omar: update Alertmanager temporary threshold and refractory period (ETA 25m) and draft anomaly rule PR (ETA 2d)
- Sam: write incident summary and schedule retro w/ runtime + SRE (ETA tomorrow)

Nisha: dashboard draft created -> https://grafana.internal/d/postmortems/text-gen-model-variant-tail-1943216789 (internal). Comments welcome.
Omar: alert threshold updated: p99_euw1 set to 1.25s, for: 12m, muted 40m starting 11:18 UTC.
Sam: thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for any extra traces or notes. :thumbsup:
Nisha: final note - please attach any perf test results or kernel experiment notes to the dashboard docs so retro has context.
Sam: last check 11:27 UTC. closing thread for now.
